import numpy as np


def r(x):
    # Maps x to the exact grid spacing representative of its discretization bin.
    # Because the program rounds 1/h to the nearest integer N, any input in the
    # same bin produces the exact same numerical trajectory.
    h = max(float(x), 1e-4)
    N = max(4, int(round(1.0 / h)))
    return 1.0 / N


def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # Trajectory similarity: the outputs must be identical (within tolerance)
    # because they correspond to the same discretized grid and time steps.
    return abs(y_orig - y_new) <= 1e-6
